Spoke with the Shenandoah Valley convention & visitors bureau (CVB).

They want to drive weekend getaway trips from the DC area -- road trips, family travel and leisure travelers, plus people who like outdoor adventure (hiking, wineries). Budget $12,000 total, Premion Streaming TV only. Target DC metro households. Goal is visits to the destination website and hotel bookings. They didn't say how to divide the budget between audiences.
